summary: Validated 2 bug fixes for NextGe Copro: P0 (dashboard health-audit 502/timeout crash) and P1 (invoice edit - Nature de depense field disabled + not persisting). Both confirmed FIXED via backend pytest, direct curl, and e2e Playwright flows on ACP 'Les Alisiers Test' (copropriete_id=bilan-secure).

minor.issue: Invoice created successfully with supplier='' (empty) even though 'Fournisseur *' is marked required in the frontend UI. Backend does not enforce non-empty supplier. Not related to the P0/P1 fixes under test; found incidentally while creating a regression-check invoice via UI automation. Test invoice was deleted after discovery (DELETE /api/invoices/{id} returned 200).

action_items: (Minor, optional, not blocking) Consider enforcing supplier selection server-side on invoice creation to match the frontend's 'required' UI hint.
No action required for the P0/P1 fixes - both validated end-to-end and working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: health_audit.py fix verified: GET /api/dashboard/health-audit for the test ACP responds in ~0.16s (well under the 20s asyncio.wait_for guard and the 3s target), returns score=66, health_label='Moyen', stats={invoices_unpaid:16, invoices_overdue:16, duplicates:0, orphans:1, unbalanced:0, owners_late:1, owners_pending:0} - matches expected values exactly. Dashboard UI (Sante comptable widget) renders the same figures correctly.

InvoicesPage.js openEditInvoice() fix verified: editing a single-line invoice (FA-2025-0014, GoodExperience Properties) shows an ENABLED 'Nature de depense' select (data-testid=invoice-category-select, is_disabled()==False), changed from 'Travaux divers' to 'Nettoyage batiment selon contrat', PCMN auto-updated to 61050, saved successfully, reopened and confirmed the new value persisted (no revert to stale value).

backend/routes/invoices.py update_invoice() fix verified: PUT without `lines` payload on a single-line legacy invoice correctly resynced the stored line to the new nature/account. Confirmed indirectly via UI reopen persistence check (pytest unit test also passes: test_editing_top_level_category_syncs_stale_legacy_line).

Genuine multi-line invoice regression check (B00041885 / FA-2025-0007, B'Cover by Baloise, 3 distinct lines totalling 149.81 EUR) correctly shows grayed/disabled top-level Nature de depense ('-- Aucune --') and stays in 'Lignes multiples (3)' mode - this is the EXPECTED/CORRECT behavior per spec. After a save (attempted status change), all 3 lines remained intact with the same amounts (119.99 + 11.47 + 18.35 = 149.81).

New standard invoice creation flow works and appears correctly in the Factures list (FA-2026-0003, TEST-STD-9001, 123.45 EUR, category Travaux divers/61066) - flow is unaffected by this session's fix, confirming no regression.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one throwaway test invoice (TEST-STD-9001 / FA-2026-0003) on ACP 'Les Alisiers Test' during the new-invoice regression check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both P0 (health-audit perf/correctness) and P1 (invoice edit category sync + multi-line preservation) fixes are fully validated and working: pytest (5/5 new tests + 5/5 related regression tests all pass), curl (score=66/Moyen matches spec), and Playwright e2e (edit single-line invoice category persists after save+reopen; genuine multi-line invoice untouched; new invoice creation unaffected). Only unrelated minor finding: invoice creation allows empty supplier despite required-field UI marker - low priority, not in scope of this session's diff.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - both bugs already fixed by main agent prior to this test pass; this was first e2e validation confirming the fixes work as intended.
